name: Ginger
description: The universal warming root — fresh in chai, dried in every tradition's pharmacy.

tcm.note: Fresh is warm; dried (gan jiang) is hot.

histamine.note: Not just safe — traditionally considered histamine-friendly.

nutrition.highlight: gingerol fresh, shogaol dried — different drugs

effects.note: Ginger powder has gone head to head with mefenamic acid and ibuprofen for period pain in randomised trials and come out equivalent — a genuinely well-replicated finding, not a folk claim standing alone. The trial dose, around a gram a day, is close to what a well-seasoned dish delivers. A possible effect, not a promise — response to it varies from person to person.
